_doc: #1747 (reopened 2026-08-06) — THE PUBLISHED Devastating Slam ROW, captured verbatim. This fixture is
EVIDENCE, not an authored shape: every field below is a byte-for-byte transcription of what the live
content pipeline serves, so a test reading it measures the product players actually run.
WHY IT EXISTS: the #1809 fixture (aoe_splash_target_filter.json) pins target_filter 1 (TF_NOT_TEAM),
hand-transcribed from a MobTemplate read on 2026-08-01. The corpus PUBLISHED ON 2026-08-04 carries
target_filter 0 (TF_NONE) for the same row. That divergence is the whole reopened defect: the sim
resolver is faithful, the data it is fed is not. Re-capture this file (pointer -> payload -> path) on
any republish; never edit a field by hand.
GEOMETRY (cell = y*20 + x, GRID_W 20) — the reported cast: the boss aims at a player ONE cell away, so
its own radius-2 circle swallows its own cell. Shared with fixtures/aoe_splash_target_filter.json so the
two rows differ in exactly ONE variable: the filter.
105 = the caster mob (5,5)   104 = its mob ally (4,5)   106 = the enemy player (6,5) = the aimed cell
